name: Account Management Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the status of an account management instruction.

RECE.name: Received
RECE.definition: The account management instruction has been received and is acknowledged.

ACCP.name: Accepted
ACCP.definition: The account management instruction has been validated and accepted.

EXEC.name: Processing Ongoing
EXEC.definition: The account management instruction is being processed and the confirmation will follow.

STNP.name: Sent To Next Party
STNP.definition: The account management instruction has been sent to the next party, for example, the next intermediary.
